title: The boxes from the door, the week before
logline: The garage from the doorway a week before the editor: thirty-nine boxes and one flat-packed against the wall, the lamp, the pup's bed by the door with him in it. The book's private volume, from the threshold, almost done.

panels.composition: The garage from its doorway with a wall of numbered boxes and one flat-packed box leaning beside them, a lit lamp on the drafting table, an old three-legged dog in a bed by the door.

characters.pose: in the bed by the door

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage studio seen from its doorway with a wall of numbered cardboard boxes and one flat-packed box leaning beside them, a lit lamp on a drafting table and an old three-legged dog in a bed by the door, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
